svg.text: MINCHO-LIKE authored source / same ink DNA, weight and canvas
Only bone rules change: angle, length, bend, position and terminal direction
Horizontal bars; a calm, vertical axis
Rising bars and an outward left sweep
Descending bars; lower marks step down
Shorter bars and closer inner roots
Open lower strokes and wider outer marks
Opposing bar angles and a shifted axis
All designs retain the body and two detached marks. No per-cell resizing or optical auto-correction.
